Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Mariano Duncan?

Mariano Duncan is 63 years old.

When was Mariano Duncan born?

Mariano Duncan was born on March 13, 1963.

Where was Mariano Duncan born?

Mariano Duncan was born in San Pedro de Macoris, Dominican Republic.

How tall is Mariano Duncan?

Mariano Duncan is 6-0 (183 cm) tall.

How much did Mariano Duncan weigh when playing?

Mariano Duncan weighed 160 lbs (72 kg) when playing.

How many seasons did Mariano Duncan play?

Mariano Duncan played 12 seasons.

Is Mariano Duncan in the Hall of Fame?

Mariano Duncan has not been elected into the Hall of Fame.

What position did Mariano Duncan play?

Mariano Duncan was a Second Baseman, Shortstop and Leftfielder.

How many hits did Mariano Duncan have?

Mariano Duncan had 1,247 hits over his career.

How many home runs did Mariano Duncan have?

Mariano Duncan had 87 home runs over his career.

What was Mariano Duncan's average?

Mariano Duncan had a .267 average over his career.

How many teams has Mariano Duncan played for?

Mariano Duncan played for 5 teams; the Cincinnati Reds, Los Angeles Dodgers, New York Yankees, Philadelphia Phillies and Toronto Blue Jays.

How many World Series has Mariano Duncan won?

Mariano Duncan has won 2 World Series.

When did Mariano Duncan retire?

Mariano Duncan last played in 1997.

What are Mariano Duncan's nicknames?

Dunc, Dunky are nicknames for Mariano Duncan.
